methodology.goal: Add PB-V23-style add-ons to V9+ and V18+ no-limit base frameworks and compare with PB-V23.
methodology.addon_logic: Same as PB-V23 focus variant: PB-V20 MA20-retest add-on timing, max5 spacing5, scan to available data end, PB-V22 loose confluence structural stop, next-open execution after close-based break, 15% close-based catastrophic line.
methodology.v9_base: V9+ deterministic entry cohort using weekly-core independent mother exit. Gross return, no extra costs applied.
methodology.v18_base: V18+ no-limit candidate pool using V17 runner mother exit and V18 fee/tax/slippage stress. Add-ons also receive the same stress adjustment.
